name: Shotwars.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Shotwars.io is a shooting game. This is an arena fighter where all players spawn armed to the teeth and must seek out more weapons, more ammo, and finally blow each other away. It takes much skill to survive in the world of Shotwars.io where you'll be taking potshots at each other with all kinds of shotguns, AK47's, and bazookas. This is a game about aim and a game about survival. You'll be fighting toe to toe and face to face with other players from around the world in real-time. It is as thrilling as it is bizarre. Lock, load, and let's go.
